notes.title: Toast Time is in Humble Bundie!
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.humblebundle.com/][img]http://toasttime.co.uk/_images/humble-bundle.png[/img][/url]

Hey hey! Toast Time is in the latest [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/]Humble Bundle[/url]! We're alongside some great games by developers we adore, which makes us warm and fuzzy inside. If Toast Time is on your wishlist (and even if it's not), you'll want to check it out! 

[h1]Friendship Club is out now![/h1]

Our new title Friendship Club is available now on Steam Early Access! It's a bullet-hell party game that we've been working on openly for around 10 months now. If a hyperactive blend of Psychonauts and Fight Club sounds like your cup of tea, check that out too!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/332760

Development Blog: http://timmybibble.com/blog/

notes.title: Toast Time now available on SteamOS + Linux
notes.notes:
Good morning fellow breakfast revellers! 

Today we've released Toast Time on to Linux platforms, and you can grab it right away! We've internally tested on Ubuntu 14.04, Fedora and even SteamOS, so there shouldn't be any issues. 

If you experience any problems, let us know and we'll fire up the bug-fix ovens right away. 

Happy toasting! :)
- Ashley & Nick

notes.title: First update. General bug fixes.
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Attention fellow toasters![/b][/h1] [i]We've just released the first small update to Toast Time.[/i]

[h1]What's changed?[/h1]
[list]
[*] Trading Cards now fully published! This was one small toggle in the monolithic Steam dashboard that we somehow missed during launch. Let us know if these still aren't working.
[*] We fixed a crash bug that happened on any level with flying/pathfinding enemies. This mostly happened on level 20. Boom!
[*] We temporarily muted some pop-up dialogs that happen if an audio file fails to load. This happens on machines with a limited number of sound channels (or something).
[/list]

[h1]What's left to change?[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix the shockwave shader on Windows platforms.
[*]Include full-size wallpapers that open from within the game. The buttons currently do nothing.
[*]Better support for Windows touch / 2-in-1 devices.
[*]People have asked about Linux support... and we're looking into it!
[*]And finally, here's one for you! If you're experiencing problems on load, take a look at upgrading your graphics drivers.
[/list]

Until next time,
Ashley & Nick

notes.title: 2014 Intel Level Up Game Developer Contest Winners Announced
notes.notes:
Intel® today announced the nine winning teams for the 2014 Intel® Level Up Game Developer Contest, each being offered worldwide distribution via Steam!

The 2014 Intel® Level Up Game Developer Contest asks game developers to submit their playable proofs of concept, alphas, betas, and unreleased demos for a chance to win cash prizes and ultimately be distributed via Steam. The categories, winners, and links to where you can find the games on Steam, can be found on the 2014 Intel® Level Up Contest Hall of Fame.

You can read full details of the contest over on the official Intel® Level Up Game Developer Contest.
